Course description

A single placement lesson for the whole major. It checked your probability, how you interpret inference results, and a short proof, so the major could start at the right place. You finished it on October 5, 2026. Probability calculation was solid. Interpreting p-values and intervals needed work, so S150 came next.

Learning objectives

  1. Show which parts of introductory probability you can already do.
  2. Show how you read p-values, confidence intervals and power.
